svg.title: 72H vNext architecture and safety boundaries
svg.desc: Japanese architecture overview of the implemented vNext app: Home Plan More, central Tokyo reference map, consented local single-point last-known location, in-app safety check and power modes, generic area-scoped disaster assessments, deterministic Safety Core and immutable plans. Osaka is schema and pipeline validation only without a map pack. vNext production acceptance passed. Live feeds, rescue services and native background behavior are not claimed.

g.font-family: Yu Gothic UI, Meiryo, Noto Sans CJK JP, sans-serif
